description: Issue a reversing invoice (storno) for an issued invoice, through Oblio's reference flow: a new invoice that references it, every line negated, its total exactly the reversed invoice's total negated. A real fiscal document, reported to ANAF like any invoice; the reversed invoice stays issued. Use it for an invoice already sent to the client or to ANAF; cancel_invoice is for one nobody has received. The invoice is read first: a cancelled one, or one that is itself a reversal, is refused. The answer carries computedTotal and oblioTotal (the storno read back, which must match) and the idempotency_key it was sent with. Moves money or makes a legal document: the client asks the user to approve each call.

expect_total.description: The total the invoice must have ("121.00"); when it differs nothing is changed. Recommended: a number can name the wrong invoice.

idempotency_key.description: Leave it out: the key is derived from the invoice being reversed, so no retry can reverse it twice. Give one only to reverse the same invoice again on purpose, after the first reversal was cancelled.

number.description: The document number as text, without its series: "0042" is not 42.

remove_payments.description: Remove the payments recorded on the reversed invoice (Oblio's refund). Default: keep them, as when the money is refunded separately.

series_name.description: The document's series, exactly as list_series shows it.

storno_series.description: The invoice series the reversing invoice is issued in, from list_series. Default: the reversed invoice's own series.

name: reverse_invoice
title: Reverse an invoice (storno)
